name: GS-Cache Inference Framework
definition: A holistic rendering framework designed to support real-time rendering of large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models at the city level, achieving >72 FPS at binocular 2K resolution by using a cache-centric de-redundancy pipeline and elastic parallel scheduling.
summary: GS-Cache is a real-time rendering framework for large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting that accelerates the derivation stage via cache-centric de-redundancy while leaving rasterization uncached to preserve visual quality.
